LESSON: MSAMIATI.

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Msamiati.

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Msamiati.. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua msamiati ambao taifa, nchi, raia, gwaride, rangi za bendera kwa unahusiana na uzalendo ili kutumia kadi za maneno yapi kuimarisha mawasiliano yanayohusiana na
2. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano msamiati wa uzalendo
3. kutambua maneno yanayoonyesha mgeni mwalikwa

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua msamiati ambao taifa, nchi, raia, gwaride, rangi za bendera kwa unahusiana na uzalendo ili kutumia kadi za maneno yapi kuimarisha mawasiliano yanayohusiana na
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua msamiati ambao taifa, nchi, raia, gwaride, rangi za bendera kwa unahusiana na uzalendo ili kutumia kadi za maneno yapi kuimarisha mawasiliano yanayohusiana na. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano msamiati wa uzalendo
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya msamiati wa uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano msamiati wa uzalendo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutambua maneno yanayoonyesha mgeni mwalikwa
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua maneno yanayoonyesha mgeni mwalikwa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Msamiati. using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Msamiati. in the examples.
2. Explain Msamiati. to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Msamiati..
4. Show that you can: kutambua msamiati ambao taifa, nchi, raia, gwaride, rangi za bendera kwa unahusiana na uzalendo ili kutumia kadi za maneno yapi kuimarisha mawasiliano yanayohusiana na

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Msamiati. using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Msamiati. important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua msamiati ambao taifa, nchi, raia, gwaride, rangi za bendera kwa unahusiana na uzalendo ili kutumia kadi za maneno yapi kuimarisha mawasiliano yanayohusiana na
2. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano msamiati wa uzalendo
3. kutambua maneno yanayoonyesha mgeni mwalikwa

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
